mentions.name: Kamakiri Pages
mentions.description: A CLI-first static hosting service built as a homegrown alternative after finding no Japanese static hosting options the author liked. AltStack.jp is planned to be migrated to it within the next two weeks.
mentions.problem: The author didn't like any of the available Japanese options for hosting a static site, and hosting a directory of Japanese alternatives on an American CDN felt off.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I started building my own static hosting service: Kamakiri Pages [2]. It's CLI-first.
